decisions.reason: The assessment-date and vehicle-identity display refinements do not change the required editable formats, report variants, PDF export, or future-editing capability.
The source Requirement's date and vehicle-identity display changes do not alter the dashboard's score fields, heading, or result prominence.
The display refinements do not change the required fonts, icons, design assets, or their intended handoff use.
Assessment-date and vehicle-identity presentation are independent of the content and bullet-point format of the result explanation.
The source change does not modify the RR-01 identifier or its consistency rule; the report-code instruction is a separate clause already represented in this Requirement.
The source Requirement's refinements do not necessarily alter the separately specified internal-page header content or styling.
The field-level refinements support the existing premium-style goal but do not change its current design approach or refinement priorities.
The assessment-date and vehicle-section changes do not necessarily change the footer's presentation or page coverage.
The customer-field display refinements are independent of the final-page confidentiality warning's presence, message, and visual treatment.
Changing the assessment-date placeholder and vehicle-identity presentation does not alter report-variant selection or risk and exposure mapping.
